display_long_description:
Step into Boxing Beat  VR: XMAS, a cozy rhythm boxing experience set on an outdoor snow-covered ring beneath twinkling lights and gentle snowfall. Time your punches to festive remixes, feel satisfying impact with Vibrate, and enjoy crisp visuals with High Quality mode — all tuned for Meta Quest. 

What you’ll do

Punch on beat to stack combos and chase perfect streaks.

Master three difficulties — Easy, Medium, Hard — each with tighter timing windows and denser patterns.

Start fast with a streamlined Tutorial and jump straight into holiday action. 

The vibe

Open-air Christmas arena: red ring dusted with snow, warm lights, and sparkling accents.

Warm & Cozy UI: floating panels, big readable buttons designed for VR comfort.

Festive feedback: snowy particle bursts and gentle chimes when you land hits on time. 

Why it’s fun

Rhythm-first boxing: simple to pick up, rewarding to master.

Comfortable in VR: Clean targets, and cozy lighting for long play sessions.

Join the holiday fight, ride the groove, and unleash that merry uppercut. Boxing Beat Xmas is where beat meets blizzard — see you on the snowy canvas.
